Capability metadata for a time-series foundation model

Source: R/capabilities.R
new_tsfm_capabilities.Rd

A tsfm_capabilities object is a small record describing what a model can and cannot do. It is attached to every model returned by tsfm_pretrained() and is used for pre-flight validation: a fit or forecast call is rejected with an informative error before any tensor work if the request exceeds the model's declared capabilities.

new_tsfm_capabilities(
  architecture,
  max_context,
  max_horizon = Inf,
  quantiles = c("native", "none"),
  quantile_levels = NULL,
  multivariate = FALSE,
  samples = FALSE,
  past_covariates = FALSE,
  future_covariates = FALSE,
  static_covariates = FALSE,
  fine_tunable = FALSE,
  license = NA_character_
)

Arguments

architecture

Character scalar, the architecture key (e.g. "ttm").

max_context

Integer, the maximum supported context length.

max_horizon

Numeric scalar, the maximum supported forecast horizon, or Inf when the architecture has no smaller declared limit.

quantiles

One of "native" (the model emits quantiles directly) or "none".

quantile_levels

Numeric vector of quantile levels the checkpoint can emit, or NULL when a native-quantile architecture accepts arbitrary levels.

multivariate, samples, past_covariates, future_covariates, static_covariates, fine_tunable

Reserved logical fields. They must remain FALSE in contract v1 because the forward signature has no channel for those inputs or outputs.

license

Character scalar, the SPDX identifier of the weight licence.

Value

A tsfm_capabilities object.
